spec.baseline: Equal-weight buy-and-hold portfolio across BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT, and zero-trade cash baseline (0% return).

costs.assumptions: Binance USD-M Futures VIP 0 taker fee of 4.5 bps (with BNB discount) plus 1.5 bps slippage per side (12.0 bps roundtrip). Actual signed 8-hour perpetual funding rate cash flows applied at settlement marks.

evaluation.plan: Evaluate trend-following expressions (ROC, Donchian Breakout, EMA crossover) across development data (2021-2024). Compute Factor Rank IC and evaluate execution with ml4t.backtest.Engine. Holdout period (2025-01-01 to 2026-07-31) remains strictly unread until final validation.

spec.falsifier: Reject the thesis if: 1. Mean forward Information Coefficient (Rank IC) at horizons H in [1h, 4h, 24h, 72h] is less than 0.015 or p-value >= 0.05. 2. Annualized net post-cost Sharpe ratio fails to exceed 0.80 on development data. 3. Maximum drawdown exceeds 25.0%. 4. Trading fee and slippage drag consumes more than 40.0% of gross strategy returns.
spec.mechanism:
1. Information Underreaction & Capital Constraints: Retail and institutional participants adjust positions
   gradually rather than instantaneously, creating multi-day return autocorrelation.
2. Forced Liquidation Spirals: Highly leveraged positions experience cascading liquidations during directional
   moves, accelerating and prolonging trend continuation.
3. Execution Flow Dynamics: Institutional algorithmic execution slices large parent orders over hours and days,
   creating persistent directional pressure that trend-following rules exploit.
spec.thesis: Time-Series Momentum (TSMOM) generates positive risk-adjusted returns across major crypto perpetuals (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT) because directional trends exhibit persistence over multi-day horizons after realistic taker commissions (4.5 bps), slippage (1.5 bps), and 8-hour funding cash flows.

trials.description: Time-Series Momentum baseline using multi-horizon Rate of Change (24h, 72h, 168h lookback returns). Long when momentum is positive, flat/short when negative.
Donchian Channel Breakout trend following across 24-bar, 48-bar, and 168-bar channels. Long on upper breakout, exit/short on lower breakdown.
Moving average trend filter using Fast EMA vs Slow EMA (12/48 and 24/168 hour spans).
Factor diagnostics across ROC, Donchian, and EMA momentum formulations: Spearman Rank IC, decay profile across forward horizons (1h, 4h, 24h, 72h), and quantile spread monotonicity.
